ForecourtAuth._comment_SeedClientId_SeedClientSecret: TEMPORARY, testing-only - fill these in locally with the client_id/client_secret from AdminCustomerController's response, do not commit real values. See ForecourtAuthOptions.cs. Leave blank to skip seeding (e.g. once you've already seeded Windows Credential Manager once).
ForecourtAuth._comment_StartupTestRequestUrl: TEMPORARY, testing-only - one authenticated GET made on startup to prove the token flow works end to end. Remove once a real verify-flow integration exists.

Logging._comment_LogLevelsToPersist: Same key/format as every other El* service's Logging:LogLevelsToPersist (see ElApp.AuthService.Web's Mvc/Configurations/Appsettings.cs, ElApp.MainExternal.Service's appsettings.json) - comma-separated Serilog.Events.LogEventLevel names. 'none' persists nothing; unset/blank defaults to Fatal,Error,Warning.
